newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Kerry shares slip after downgrade talk.
newsitem.headline: Kerry shares slip after downgrade talk.

text.p: Shares in Ireland's largest food company Kerry Group Plc slipped sharply lower on Tuesday following news of a possible downgrade of its earnings forecasts by its broker Davy Stockbrokers, market sources said.
Davy said it was reviewing the company's numbers and indicated any revision would be downwards but said it had not yet issued a note to that effect.
By 1525 GMT, Kerry was down 55 Irish pence to 585 on the Dublin stock exchange having been as low as 575 earlier.
